notes.title: Who am I
notes.body: I am a junior in University of Washington, major in Human Centered Design & Engineering, Human Computer Interaction track.

notes.title: People around me
notes.body: Gloria Qi（齐沛彤） is my girlfriend, who is a senior in Informatics, University of Washington. She is also an AI PM and interned at StarDust（星辰科技） this summer, building Friday Agent and Subway RAG system.
